hero.title: Pay for the compute you
hero.subtitle: Fintela runs on two prepaid balances: Fintela tokens meter the compute the platform runs for you, and Fintela AI tokens meter your work with Fintelligent. Both are bought in packs — the bigger the pack, the lower the rate.

balances.title: Two balances,
balances.description: Every organization holds both. Each meters a different kind of work, so a heavy optimization week never eats into your agent budget — and vice versa.

compute.name: Fintela tokens
compute.description: Spent whenever the platform runs work on your behalf — the optimizer sampling parameters, the compiler validating your code. Metered per action, at a fixed rate you can budget against before you launch anything.

ai.name: Fintela AI tokens
ai.description: Spent when you work with the agent. Every message you send and every answer it returns is metered, so you only pay for the reasoning you actually ask for.

meters.messages: Charged on both input and output tokens
meters.factor: Model usage is converted into AI tokens by a conversion factor

packs.title: Token
packs.description: Packs are bought in the app and credited to your organization's balance. Prices are in US dollars.

compute.heading: Fintela tokens
compute.subheading: For optimization trials, bug tests, and every other compute-backed action in the platform.

ai.heading: Fintela AI tokens
ai.subheading: For working with Fintelligent — questions, analysis, and everything you ask the agent to do.

meter.title: What consumes
meter.description: Only work that costs compute costs you tokens. These are the published rates; anything else the platform runs for you draws on the same balances.

trial.detail: One parameter sample. The optimizer picks a vector of values, runs your strategy across the backtest window and scores its fitness. A 200-trial study spends 200 of them.

bugTest.detail: The validation run that compiles and executes your strategy or risk manager against real data before it is saved — so errors surface up front, not halfway through a study.

chat.detail: Each exchange with the agent. Its input and output tokens are multiplied by a conversion factor and drawn from your AI token balance.

balance.title: Balances belong to the organization
balance.description: Both balances sit with your organization rather than an individual seat, so everyone on the team draws from the same pool and you can see exactly where it went.

volume.title: Bigger packs, lower rate
volume.description: The effective rate drops at every tier: the largest Fintela token pack costs {{computeSave}}% less per token than the entry pack, and the largest AI token pack {{aiSave}}% less.

reads.title: Reading your results is free
reads.description: The developer API is read-only and returns work you have already paid for, so exporting portfolios, trials and baskets into your own notebooks costs nothing.

help.title: Not sure what you need?
help.description: Tell us the size of your search space and how your team plans to use the agent, and we will size a pack against a realistic workload with you.

cta.title: Start with the pack that fits
cta.description: Top up in the app whenever you need to, or talk to us first if you would rather size it against a real workload.
